title: Volume of a Tetrahedron in the First Octant
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the volume of the tetrahedron bounded by the coordinate planes and the plane x + y + z = 1.

steps.title: Establish 3D and 2D Boundary Limits
steps.mathExpression: 0 \le z \le 1 - x - y, \quad 0 \le y \le 1 - x, \quad 0 \le x \le 1
steps.explanation: The plane bounds z from above; the xy-projection is the triangle x + y <= 1 in the first quadrant.

steps.title: Integrate with Respect to z
steps.explanation: The innermost integral is simply the height.

steps.title: Integrate with Respect to y and x
steps.explanation: Integrate over triangular base in xy-plane.
